primitives.note: Q's initial burst, E's spiral hit, and R's landing burst each deal a single fixed-timing magic damage instance on cast/cast-end
Blooming Burst re-blooms up to 2 more times at a fixed 0.75s delay after the initial hit whenever it hits a champion (the dummy always counts), each bloom a separately timed damage instance
Shapesplitter passive: every basic attack adds a stack (cap 2, refreshing), and the attack that reaches 2 stacks consumes them to deal a bonus magic damage on-hit instance
Pop Blossom has a 1.25s wind-up plus a 0.6s cast time before its damage lands, during which Neeko is airborne/committed to the cast

needsBespoke.why: Q, E, R, and W's on-hit passive are all expressible with plain-cast, recast-or-multipart, and nth-hit-or-cast. Passive P (Inherent Glamour) requires an allied champion or a non-champion unit (minion/monster/ward/plant) to disguise as; since the damage and survival fights have no allies, minions or terrain, disguising cannot occur and P contributes no damage-fight logic. W's active (clone) deals no damage of its own (only the passive on-hit rider does), so it is skipped in the dummy fight and needs no primitive.

unsettled.question: Does R's 1.25s wind-up block Neeko from acting (auto-attacking, casting Q/E) before the 0.6s committed cast time begins, or can she act freely during the wind-up and only the final 0.6s is a hard commit?
options: The full 1.25s wind-up + 0.6s cast time (1.85s total) blocks all other actions, matching a charge-or-channel with total duration 1.85s
Only the 0.6s wiki 'cast time' field blocks actions; the 1.25s wind-up (highlighting the area) does not prevent auto-attacks or other casts
quotes: '''Neeko''' winds up spiritual essence over {{fd|1.25}} seconds and highlights an area around herself
On-cast effects are applied on activation.

unsettled.question: Does each of Q's up-to-2 follow-up blooms count as a separate spell cast for on-hit/on-cast item and rune interactions (e.g. procs that trigger 'on ability cast' or apply per-instance), or are they treated as part of the single original cast?
options: Each bloom is a fully separate damage/spell instance that can re-trigger on-hit or spell-based item effects
Only the initial burst counts as the 'cast'; the 2 blooms are follow-up damage from the same cast and do not re-trigger cast-based procs
quotes: the seed blooms after {{fd|0.75}} seconds to burst again, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the same area. This may occur up to 2 times per cast.

unsettled.question: NeekoW.CloneDamageTimer in the bin is 0.75 but the wiki text states the clone disappears 0.5 seconds after taking damage; since the clone deals no damage in the dummy fight this doesn't change output, but is either value authoritative for any downstream timing use?
options: Wiki's stated 0.5s is correct and the bin value is stale/unused
Bin's 0.75s is the live value and the wiki text is outdated
quotes: it will disappear prematurely after {{fd|0.5}} seconds

proposal: Neeko starts undisguised (no allied champions or other units exist to disguise as in this fight format), so Inherent Glamour contributes nothing.
Open by casting Q (Blooming Burst) on the dummy immediately; it deals its initial magic damage and then blooms up to two more times over the next 1.5 seconds for extra magic damage.
Cast E (Tangle-Barbs) as soon as its 0.25s cast time allows, adding another magic damage hit and refreshing on cooldown thereafter.
Weave in basic attacks continuously between and during ability casts; every second attack consumes Shapesplitter stacks for a bonus magic damage on-hit strike.
Cast R (Pop Blossom) once for its large burst of magic damage, accepting the wind-up/cast time before it lands; given its 90-120s cooldown it will not be available again within the 15s window.
Recast Q and E on cooldown for the remainder of the fight, continuing to auto-attack in between to keep triggering the W passive's empowered attacks.
questions: Should R be cast immediately at the start of the fight to front-load its burst, or held until after Q/E have been used, given the simulator ranks by kill time and total damage over ~15s?
Does casting W's active clone ever benefit the damage fight (e.g. via any AP/haste self-buff that could indirectly matter to attack speed/casting), or should it be omitted entirely as proposed?
How much of the 15s window is actually available for casting given R's wind-up/cast-time commitment — does this materially reduce the number of Q/E casts and auto-attacks achievable?
